turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Watch me do one.
"bike" starts with the sound "b". That is not a vowel sound, so I use a: He has a bike.
Rule: a before most sounds; an before a vowel sound (a, e, i, o, u).
Right: He has an egg. Wrong: He has a egg.

Now try one. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag.
(answer with only the missing word)
